purpose: Prospective finite-input-law estimator sensitivity gates before new bridge pilot outputs
interpretation: Sensitivity of two declared finite-knot forcing laws; tight ODE check is distinct. No claim of exact continuous OU forcing or long-run convergence.
representative_selection: Within-group medoid of finalReP,minR,time-meanR,multiregionfraction; IQRscaled L1 distance to group median, unit zeroIQR fallback, slot tie-break
analysis: Full/firsthalf/lasthalf windows; signedrestrictedintegral; no exponential fits;whole independent seeds resampled
